verdict.rationale: ComplyAdvantage Mesh is a KYC/AML compliance platform, so a hosted document-plus-selfie verification flow is a fair question for this kind of product. However, the evidence covers only sanctions, PEP and adverse-media screening, case management, webhooks and transaction monitoring. Nothing in the pack shows document capture, selfie or liveness checks, hosted or drop-in verification sessions, or SDKs, so there is no evidence the product delivers this story.
